title: Allard's Rectifiability Theorem 8.5.5 with Remark 5.6, and Corollary 8.5.7 (tangent cones are rectifiable cones)
statement: If V has locally bounded first variation in open U ⊆ ℝ^N and Θ^n(μ_V,x) exists and is > 0 for μ_V-a.e. x, then V is rectifiable (IsRectifiable V: V = v(M,θ) for some M, θ) and V has a tangent plane with positive multiplicity in the sense of Def. 1.1 at μ_V-a.e. x. Moreover (Simon 5.7): let V have locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, Θ^n(μ_V,x) = θ0, ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0, and ρ^{-n}μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and ≥ 1)}) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0. Then every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) is rectifiable and η_{0,s#}C = C (rescaledMeasure C 0 s = C.measure) for all s > 0. (Exactly AllardRectifiabilityTheorem ∧ TangentConesAreRectifiableCones.)
